text: Agile methodology is a modern way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at the start, teams work in short cycles called sprints, usually lasting two to four weeks. Before each sprint, the team chooses tasks from a backlog, which is a prioritized list of user stories describing what users need. Every day, team members meet for short standups to share progress and discuss problems. This iterative development approach allows teams to deliver working results quickly and improve them based on feedback. Agile helps teams stay flexible, communicate better, and respond to changes without losing focus on customer needs.
